**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

__Only by__ his prudence, he would have incurred a heavy loss.
questions.solution: The correct answer is** 'But for'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined part is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'But for'** should be used instead of** 'Only by'.** • **'But for'** is 'used for saying that something would have happened if something else or someone had not prevented it'. • *Example: **But for** your timely warning, we would have been unaware of the danger.* **Correct Sentence:__** ***But for** his prudence, he would have incurred a heavy loss.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • रेखांकित भाग व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है। • यहां **'Only by' **के स्थान पर **'But for'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • **'But for' **का प्रयोग यह कहने के लिए किया जाता है कि अगर कुछ और होता या किसी ने इसे रोका नहीं होता तो कुछ होता। • *Example: But for your timely warning, we would have been unaware of the danger. * 34:Tae2, The correct answer is **'He did not forgot'.**

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He did not forgot / to consult his parents / before accepting / the job offer.
questions.solution: The correct answer is **'He did not forgot'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'He did not forget' **should be used instead of **'He did not forgot'.** • We know that the helping verb '**did**' is always followed by **the base form** of the **verb i.e. "forget" in the given context**. • *Example: I **didn't know** how to answer his question.* **Correct Sentence:__** ***He did not forget** to consult his parents before accepting the job offer.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ, '**He did not forgot**' के स्थान पर '**He did not forget**' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि सहायक क्रिया '**did**' के बाद **verb** का** base form** हमेशा आता है। • *Example: I **didn't know **how to answer his question.* 35:Tec4, The correct answer is '**for**'.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He did not provide ________ his brother in his will.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer for the given blank is '**for**'.
 
• Here, **'provide for'** is a phrasal verb.
 
• In the given context it means** 'to have or make plans to deal with something that will or may happen in the future**'.
 
 
• *Example: The plant will have an on-site facility that **provides for **25 years of storage of spent fuel.*
 
 
 
• If a law or agreement provides for something, it allows it to happen or exist.
 
 
• For Example - Current legislation **provides for** the detention of those suspected of terrorism.

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He did not **provide for** his brother in his will.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान का सही उत्तर '**for**' है।
 
• यहाँ, **'provide for' **एक वाक्यांश क्रिया है।
 
• दिए गए संदर्भ में इसका अर्थ है **'भविष्य में होने वाली या होने वाली किसी चीज़ से निपटने के लिए योजना बनाना'**।
 
 
• उदाहरण के लिए - The plant will have an on-site facility that provides for 25 years of storage of spent fuel.
 
 
 
• **यदि कोई कानून या समझौता कुछ प्रदान करता है, तो वह इसे होने या अस्तित्व में रखने की अनुमति देता है।**
 
 
• उदाहरण के लिए - Current legislation provides for the detention of those suspected of terrorism.

questions.solution: The correct answer is **'is a fine'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate answer for the underlined part is** 'is a fine'.** • The adjectives '**good**' and '**fine**' are used in a different contexts. • "**Fine**" generally applies to conditions of health, social or financial conditions, or arts. • "**Good**" generally applies to conditions of moral behavior. • *Example: By the way, the Meat Lover's Skillet **is a fine piece** of work.* **Correct Sentence:__** *This antique vase** is a fine **piece of work.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • रेखांकित भाग के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर** 'is a fine' **है। • विशेषण '**good**' और '**fine**' अलग-अलग संदर्भों में उपयोग किए जाते हैं। • "**Fine**" आम तौर पर स्वास्थ्य, सामाजिक या वित्तीय स्थितियों, या कला की स्थितियों पर लागू होता है। • "**Good**" आमतौर पर नैतिक व्यवहार की स्थितियों पर लागू होता है। • *Example: By the way, the Meat Lover's Skillet is **a fine piece** of work.* 37:Teaf, The correct answer is **'What did they teach you at the creative writing workshop?'**

(Active Voice) • Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • उदाहरण: • *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Then they gave me an injection to counteract inflammation.

B. They used a special medicine to clear out all the worms from my body.

C. It had a small dispensary where I was washed and my wounds treated.

D. Tournavista was an agricultural colony.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**DCBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
 
• **Sentence D **will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence talking about '**Tournavista**'.
 
• **Sentence C** will be used afterward because it is talking about a small dispensary which is located in '**Tournavista**'.
 
• **Sentence B **will be the next sentence because it is connected with **Sentence C. **It further tells what they used to treat her wounds.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence A **will be used because after using a special medicine to clear ut the worms from her body, they gave her an injection to counteract inflammation.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **D**: Tournavista was an agricultural colony.
 
• **C**: It had a small dispensary where I was washed and my wounds treated.
 
• **B**: They used a special medicine to clear out all the worms from my body.
 
• **A**: Then they gave me an injection to counteract inflammation.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Tournavista was an agricultural colony. It had a small dispensary where I was washed and my wounds treated. They used a special medicine to clear out all the worms from my body. Then they gave me an injection to counteract inflammation.*
